item.title: Crystal Cave at Sequoia National Park Is Open Again and Tickets Are on Sale Now
The Push to Raise Shasta Dam Just Got $40 Million in Federal Backing
item.description: The federal government is putting $40 million toward early planning efforts to raise Shasta Dam, reigniting a debate that has drawn opposition from tribal leaders, environmental groups and state officials for years.

item.title: Dead Seabirds Washing Up on Point Reyes Beaches Linked to Avian Influenza
item.description: Avian influenza appears to have made its way to Point Reyes National Seashore after a sharp uptick in dead seabirds along park beaches raised alarms among wildlife officials.

item.title: Yosemite's Attendance Climbed in 2025 and Dropping Reservations Could Send 2026 Even Higher
item.description: Yosemite drew more than 4.2 million visitors in 2025, making it the park's fourth-busiest year on record despite a government shutdown and stretched-thin staff.

item.title: A 300-Mile Trail Through Northern California's Redwoods Is One Step Closer to Reality
item.description: The Great Redwood Trail Agency board approved its master plan this week, laying out the blueprint for designing, building and managing 231 miles of trail through Mendocino, Trinity and Humboldt counties.

item.title: Gray Whale Found Dead Near the Golden Gate Bridge Was Likely Struck by a Ship
item.description: A 42-foot gray whale found floating in San Francisco Bay near the Golden Gate Bridge earlier this week was likely killed after being struck by a vessel.

item.title: Sierra Snowmelt Is Running Two Months Early and Northern California Water Managers Are Racing to Keep Up
item.description: Record-breaking March heat is melting California's Sierra snowpack at a rate of roughly 1% per day, pushing runoff into reservoirs two months ahead of schedule.

item.title: Skunk Train Guides Stumbled Upon a Missing Hiker in the Redwoods and Helped Save Her Life - Active NorCal
item.description: A woman who had been missing for several days in the redwood forest near Camp Noyo was rescued on March 18 after two Skunk Train railbike guides found her during a routine excursion.

item.title: 19-Year-Old Petaluma Man Found Dead in the Truckee River After Multi-Day Search - Active NorCal
item.description: A 19-year-old Petaluma man who disappeared while swimming in the Truckee River near Floriston on Saturday has been found dead after a three-day search.

item.title: The Numbers Behind Northern California's Historic March Heat Wave - Active NorCal
item.description: Northern California just lived through a heat wave that had no business showing up in March.

item.title: Pilot Killed in Plane Crash Near Olympic Valley While Approaching Truckee Tahoe Airport - Active NorCal
item.description: A pilot was killed Sunday evening when a small plane crashed in remote, rugged terrain southwest of Olympic Valley while en route to Truckee Tahoe Airport.

item.title: Rangers Arrest Yosmite Base Jumper for Instagram Video. He Claims its AI.
item.description: A Southern California man is facing federal charges after rangers say he illegally BASE jumped inside Yosemite National Park and then posted the footage online.

item.title: A Splitboarder's Rough Day Above 12,000 Feet on Mount Shasta Ended With a Team Rescue
item.description: A splitboarder's backcountry session on Mount Shasta took a serious turn on March 20 when altitude sickness left him stranded thousands of feet above the trailhead.

item.title: Kayaker Dies After Capsizing on Tomales Bay Near Point Reyes - Active NorCal
item.description: A weekend kayaking outing on Tomales Bay ended in tragedy after a 37-year-old Los Angeles woman died when her kayak flipped near Point Reyes National Seashore.
